description: Mobile-first personal assistant web UI powered by Pi

fs=require('node:fs'),Ajv=require('ajv/dist/2020');const ajv=new Ajv({strict:false});ajv.compile(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/contracts/browser-host.v1.schema.json','utf8')));const validate=ajv.compile(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/contracts/distribution-packages.v1.schema.json','utf8')));const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),yaml=require('js-yaml'),Ajv=require('ajv/dist/2020');const schema=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('packages/contracts/wuxianpi-package.schema.json','utf8'));const ajv=new Ajv({allErrors:true});const validate=ajv.compile(schema);const validateMcp=ajv.compile({\$defs:schema.\$defs,\$ref:'#/\$defs/mcpServerConfig'});const fail=m=>{throw new Error(m)};const assert=(x,m)=>{if(!x)fail(m)};const valid=(x,m)=>{if(!validate(x))fail(m+': '+JSON.stringify(validate.errors))};const roots=fs.readdirSync('examples/packages',{withFileTypes:true}).filter(x=>x.isDirectory()).map(x=>path.join('examples/packages',x.name));assert(roots.length>0,'no package examples');const manifests=roots.map(root=>({root,file:path.join(root,'wuxianpi-package.json'),value:JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'wuxianpi-package.json'),'utf8'))}));const base=manifests[0].value,p=base.id,a=p+'/artifact.fixture';const branches=[{id:p+'/extension.fixture',type:'pi.extension',name:'Extension',path:'x'},{id:p+'/skill.fixture',type:'pi.skill',name:'Skill',path:'x'},{id:p+'/prompt.fixture',type:'pi.prompt',name:'Prompt',path:'x'},{id:p+'/theme.fixture',type:'pi.theme',name:'Theme',path:'x'},{id:p+'/mcp.fixture',type:'mcp.server',name:'MCP',config:'x',assistantSelectable:true},{id:p+'/web.fixture',type:'wuxianpi.webExtension',name:'Web',manifest:'x',assistantSelectable:true},{id:p+'/renderer.fixture',type:'wuxianpi.renderer',name:'Renderer',manifest:'x',contentTypes:['fixture.result']},{id:p+'/assistant.fixture',type:'wuxianpi.assistantTemplate',name:'Assistant',manifest:'x',kind:'functional',defaultBindings:[]},{id:p+'/context.fixture',type:'wuxianpi.context',name:'Context',path:'x',format:'markdown',assistantSelectable:true},{id:p+'/experience.fixture',type:'wuxianpi.experience',name:'Experience',experienceSpaceId:'fixture.shared',basePath:'x',mainstream:{type:'https-json',url:'https://example.com/experience.json'},updatePolicy:{strategy:'three-way-merge',priority:['local-verified-correction','mainstream','package-base'],localCorrections:'preserve'},assistantSelectable:true},{id:p+'/runtime.fixture',type:'wuxianpi.runtime',name:'Runtime',path:'x'},{id:p+'/app.fixture',type:'openhouse.app',name:'App',manifest:'x'},{id:p+'/service.fixture',type:'service-manager.service',name:'Service',manifest:'x'},{id:p+'/artifact.fixture',type:'artifact',name:'Artifact',artifactId:a,purpose:'Fixture'}];const declared=schema.\$defs.contributionBase.properties.type.enum;assert(JSON.stringify([...declared].sort())===JSON.stringify(branches.map(x=>x.type).sort()),'contribution branch fixtures do not match enum');for(const contribution of branches)valid({...base,contributions:[contribution]},'invalid '+contribution.type+' branch');assert(!validate({...base,categories:['invalid-category']}),'invalid category accepted');for(const {root,file,value} of manifests){valid(value,'invalid example '+file);const ids=new Set,artifacts=new Set(value.artifacts.map(x=>x.id));for(const artifact of value.artifacts){assert(artifact.id.startsWith(value.id+'/'),file+' unscoped artifact '+artifact.id);assert(!ids.has(artifact.id),file+' duplicate id '+artifact.id);ids.add(artifact.id)}for(const contribution of value.contributions){assert(contribution.id.startsWith(value.id+'/'),file+' unscoped contribution '+contribution.id);assert(!ids.has(contribution.id),file+' duplicate id '+contribution.id);ids.add(contribution.id);for(const key of ['path','config','manifest','basePath'])if(contribution[key])assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(root,contribution[key])),file+' missing '+contribution[key]);if(contribution.type==='mcp.server'){const child=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,contribution.config),'utf8'));assert(validateMcp(child),file+' invalid MCP '+JSON.stringify(validateMcp.errors));assert(!Object.hasOwn(child,'authentication'),file+' uses obsolete MCP authentication field')}if(contribution.type==='pi.skill'){const skillFile=path.join(root,contribution.path,'SKILL.md');assert(fs.existsSync(skillFile),file+' missing SKILL.md');const text=fs.readFileSync(skillFile,'utf8'),match=text.match(/^---?
([\s\S]*?)?
---(?:?
|$)/);assert(match,file+' invalid Skill frontmatter');const front=yaml.load(match[1]);assert(front&&typeof front==='object',file+' invalid Skill YAML');assert(typeof front.name==='string'&&front.name.length<=64&&/^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(front.name),file+' invalid Skill name');assert(typeof front.description==='string'&&front.description.length>0&&front.description.length<=1024,file+' invalid Skill description')}if(contribution.type==='wuxianpi.assistantTemplate')for(const id of contribution.defaultBindings)assert(value.contributions.some(x=>x.id===id),file+' missing binding '+id);if(contribution.type==='artifact')assert(artifacts.has(contribution.artifactId),file+' missing artifact '+contribution.artifactId)}if(value.build.mode==='artifact')for(const id of value.build.artifactIds)assert(artifacts.has(id),file+' missing build artifact '+id)}const mcp={id:'fixture',name:'Fixture',transport:'streamable-http',url:'https://example.com/mcp',auth:'oauth'};assert(validateMcp(mcp),'valid MCP fixture rejected');assert(!validateMcp({...mcp,authentication:{type:'oauth'}}),'obsolete MCP authentication field accepted');console.log('Package contracts: examples, branches, paths, IDs, bindings, MCP, and Skills passed')" && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),crypto=require('node:crypto');for(const entry of fs.readdirSync('examples/packages',{withFileTypes:true}).filter(x=>x.isDirectory())){const root=path.join('examples/packages',entry.name),planFile=path.join(root,'install-plan.example.json');if(!fs.existsSync(planFile))continue;const plan=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(planFile,'utf8'));if(typeof plan.manifestPath!=='string'||typeof plan.manifestDigest!=='string')throw new Error(planFile+' missing manifestPath or manifestDigest');const bytes=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,plan.manifestPath)),manifest=JSON.parse(bytes),digest=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');if(plan.packageId!==manifest.id)throw new Error(planFile+' packageId mismatch');if(plan.manifestDigest!==digest)throw new Error(planFile+' manifestDigest mismatch: expected '+digest+' got '+plan.manifestDigest)}console.log('Install-plan manifest digests passed')" && bash packaging/termux/build-release.sh --help >/dev/null
scripts.product:check: npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run runtime:typecheck && npm run contracts:check
